abilities.name: Bounded resource search
abilities.function: Search an area around an origin for sources of one known resource and collect up to a quantity, one navigate, probe or gather step per round, within path, time and energy limits.
abilities.costs: No cost of its own: each round runs one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: actual distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and carried mass, at most 0.8 distance per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the energy reserve; a step that does not fit is not taken and the search stops. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
abilities.effects: start: resource, radius around x, y (default your position), path, time, energy, reserve, quantity. Candidates: sources of that resource you see now, or remember out of view, inside the radius, with ripe stock; nearest reach first; sources made by another person are left alone. It walks to one with navigate, inspects it with probe, then gathers min(stock, quantity left, units the energy allows). Sources seen empty are noted, not visited. If none is known it may walk to observed dry ground inside the radius to see its unseen parts; one known but beyond the limits stops it. It completes at the quantity or when nothing is left (perhaps with 0), and stops at a limit, health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 from 22 or an injury in the last round. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks all; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

execution.progress: start or resume continues with the same action, one step per round, until it completes or stops; a round taken by another action pauses it. Steps and costs stay.

abilities.name: Reciprocal conversation
abilities.function: A two-person conversation session over ordinary tell: propose it to someone you see within 5, each of you joins, then speak with contribute, optionally answering a heard utterance of the other.
abilities.costs: propose, join, resume, contribute: tell's cost, 1 round, 0 energy, 0 material. pause, leave, cancel: no energy, no speech; they only use your action. Study: 1 round; needs tell.
abilities.effects: propose: participants [you, them], topic (max 80), rounds 1-20 until expiry; says an invitation with the session id; only someone who hears it can join. join (with session and topic, the proposer too) and resume say a short tell; contribute says text (max 240) as tell; optional respondsTo: a heard utterance id of theirs in it. Each needs them alive within 5; words count only if they heard them. Active once both joined and heard each other. An answer with new words to their earlier utterance records a reciprocal exchange. Another action (wait is silence), urgent risk or more than 5 apart pauses it; both must resume. leave, cancel, death or expiry ends it. Your record shows only your acts, what you heard and changes within 5 of you. Grants nothing; no reward.

execution.progress: Each mode is one complete action; a session spans rounds through separate actions of both people.

abilities.name: Tend rooted plants
abilities.function: Inspect an established rooted food plant in reach and its growth needs, and loosen soil or clear competing plants by hand only where the growth model has crust, compaction or competition that limits it.
abilities.costs: Study: 3 rounds, no energy; needs probe. inspect: probe's observation of the plant, 1 round, 0.2 energy. prepare (hand loosening where modeled crust or compaction limits the plant, clearing where modeled competition does) would take 3 rounds at 2 energy each and maintain 1 round at 1 energy; this world's soil and plant model has neither condition, so both take 1 round, 0 energy, and change nothing. cancel: 1 round, 0 energy. Refusals cost nothing: target not in view or reach, or not an established rooted food plant that regrows (fungi, fish, seedlings, non-food and non-regrowing plants).
abilities.effects: target: a plant you see. inspect: probe's record (stock, growth, stage, soil) and the plant's growth contract from the existing rule: growth per ripe unit, growth so far, the least rounds to the next unit at the best rate (growth scale x full daylight), the temperature range (none at minGrowth, full at optimalGrowth), moisture need, waterlogging, harvest pressure 1/(1+depletion/20) and what limits it now. The first inspection records a baseline in your patch record (one square unit around the plant, at most 8 records); later ones report the change. prepare/maintain: 'no corrective work indicated', with the reason; quantity (rounds of work) stays unused. cancel: close the record for target, or all without one. Growth runs only through the existing rule, tended or not; harvest only with gather. No water is carried. Nothing is moved, created, refunded or rewarded.

execution.progress: Every mode completes in its round; no labor is left pending, because no corrective work is indicated in this world.

session-54-sol.topic: What catches our eye here, and how we are doing

contributions.speaker: moss
contributions.text: The pale roots and red berries catch my eye against the dark meadow, even with their patches empty. I'm fed and rested, and glad you invited me. What do you enjoy noticing when supplies aren't the whole story?

contributions.speaker: sol
contributions.text: I like the shapes of the trees against the dark, and the way a familiar place feels different with someone to share it. I'm glad you're here. Is there a place you'd like us to explore when daylight returns?

contributions.speaker: sol
contributions.text: I'm going to scout a little east for food, keeping enough energy to return and rest. I'd welcome your company, or hearing about a place you'd like to explore together.

reviews.reason: Develop evidence-based food suitability assessment, not a new observation or sampling primitive. The supplied searches found probe, eat, gather and tend-rooted-plants. probe already covers observation and press/wet/heat trials, and its code must be reused; gathering, ingestion and plant-growth inspection do not establish food safety. The missing function is relating actual evidence to bounded, personally applicable nutrition, toxicity and preparation conclusions while preserving uncertainty. No universal non-ingestive edibility test is justified. An accessible specimen is currently absent, so development and individual study may proceed but assessment cannot execute on remembered meadow roots. Implementation/review waiting does not advance the world. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: One individual study round, with no study/request/registration/mastery reward. Assessment itself grants no automatic pleasure, satisfaction, physical comfort or nutrition. A completed, verified new observation or informative failed trial may be eligible for the existing experience system only when it genuinely reduces uncertainty for this actor and is applicable to their circumstances. Deduplicate by functional finding, specimen class, method and relevant conditions rather than action name. Mere unresolved reports without new evidence and repeated identical queries earn nothing. Do not invent reward balances or a new scoring schedule: absent an established applicable bounded event rule with a cap, decay and cooldown, this implementation emits evidence events but awards zero experience benefit. Ordinary familiar legitimate practice may qualify under existing rules without a novelty requirement. Comfort remains capped at 10; hunger and basic nutrition are never reduced by mood.
reviews.visualReview: Emit reusable, event-linked metadata containing action type, target reference, mode, method reference, actual progress, evidence references, and outcome status: blocked, interrupted, observed, informative-failure or unresolved. Show inspection only during a real interaction; show heat, liquid use or sample change only when those events occurred. Findings display their provenance and uncertainty separately from animation completion. A completed observation is not successful edibility verification: unresolved safety must remain visibly unresolved, and failed/incomplete actions cannot show a safe-food badge, prepared food, full progress or a success effect. Reuse probe's existing interaction visuals where applicable, recording that reuse. No visual locates unobserved roots or reveals hidden stock or properties.
reviews.specification: General operation: assess-food-suitability(target, mode, intendedConsumer, evidenceRefs, methodRef?). Applicable to any actor and accessible potential food, not one actor or root instance. Modes inspect and trial share one evidence record and evaluator. References must resolve to a currently visible target within its actual interaction range or an owned sample stack; remembered locations and resource names alone are insufficient. intendedConsumer defaults to the acting actor; assess another consumer only from legitimately available relevant facts, without revealing private state or assuming their participation. Dependencies: open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, equivalence open-baseline:probe:1; existing knowledge/evidence records; source and inventory conservation; and, for a trial, an implemented method whose physical prerequisites and measurement semantics are actually satisfied. Record code reuse explicitly in implementation. Before adding code, the current-conversation handoff must check complete existing handlers for an equivalent evaluator and reuse any equivalent implementation rather than duplicate it. Minimal executable implementation is inspect plus evidence qualification: perform probe(target, observe, intensity), then attach evidence-linked conclusions of supported, contradicted or unresolved separately for identity, nutritional usefulness, toxicity and preparation requirements. Visible morphology is not chemical analysis. Never expose hidden nutrition/toxicity fields or convert a resource label into identification. Previously learned berry nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 may be cited as prior knowledge only when identity and applicability are legitimately established; they do not transfer to roots. If evidence cannot establish safety, return 'safety unresolved; do not consume on this evidence.' Preparation is unresolved unless an applicable evidence-backed method exists. Trial mode delegates only to an executable probe press/wet/heat method with an actual diagnostic relationship to the question; otherwise refuse the trial with its missing prerequisite, not a fabricated test or a rejection of future development. Heat requires a real usable heat source and safe handling; wet requires actual usable liquid and a container/contact arrangement where necessary. Missing measurement or preparation mechanisms, if needed, remain in the current-conversation development handoff for the smallest feasible implementation; none is silently granted. No taste test, ingestion or feeding another actor is included. Costs: inspect is one simulation round and 0.2 energy through probe, with no material use. A supported physical trial is one round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 unit from a real owned sample, plus the explicitly quoted method-specific consumables, heat and risks. Do not execute an incompletely costed trial. Before commitment, report prerequisites, applicable risks and the actual debit; invalid or inaccessible targets cost no energy or material and produce no assessment result. No extra assessment surcharge or second round for interpretation. Natural hunger and other ongoing rules still execute on action/study rounds; use current vitals, not the older request snapshot. Gathering remains a separate gather action at its existing cost of 2 energy per unit and finite source stock; travel, pickup and any implemented preparation retain their existing rules. Inspection creates only an evidence record, not stock, food, tools, safety certification or mastery. Trial input is debited exactly once; the consumed 0.1 unit must be accounted for as measured residue, effluent or loss under the actual method and cannot also remain edible inventory. No implicit edible output, regrowth, nutrition or detoxification occurs. Each completed one-round interaction commits atomically with a unique event ID and work progress 1/1. Interruption or death before physical commitment cancels with progress 0/1 and no debit or finding; after commitment, costs and any real residues or hazards persist and only genuinely obtained observations survive. Cancel creates no success; resume after cancellation is a new validated interaction with normal costs. No refund of spent energy, time or used material; unspent resources remain where they were. Existing completed evidence persists with its provenance and applicability limits. No autonomous testing, ongoing maintenance or safety guarantee is created. Freshness changes, contamination and preparation effects follow only implemented processes and can invalidate prior conclusions; reassess when relevant conditions change. Established evidence eligibility, cost accounting and applicability checks must run in code, not repeated model adjudication. Other participants must communicate and act independently through their own interfaces. Never alter protected rewards, budget, goals or permissions.

args.name: urgent-food-foraging
args.function: Find and collect reachable ripe food suitable for me using actual observations, including checking previously empty plants for real replenishment. Support a bounded emergency search while satiety is below 8 if health and available energy still permit it, rather than treating low satiety alone as a reason to abandon obtaining food.
args.conditions: At tick 138 I have health 100, satiety 19.8, energy about 13.53, no inventory, and position (28.5,34.5). The latest berry search exhausted its area without collecting anything. Multiple remembered food plants were empty when observed. Berries are personally tested safe with nutrition 8. There are no currently visible actors or stocked food sources. Recent northern animal sightings make that direction concerning.
args.inputs: Actual visible and remembered source identities, current observations, personally known food suitability, reachable terrain, and explicit time, travel, energy and health limits.
args.costs: Method and total cost are unknown; observation, movement, gathering and any learning must consume their real time and energy. No food or knowledge should be created merely by this request.
args.effects: A usable emergency-foraging method, or an explanation of the feasible existing actions and limitations. Do not assume stale empty-source records remain current, invent ripe stock, or grant unearned mastery.

reviews.reason: The searched related capabilities cover the component actions but not the requested control behavior. bounded-resource-search explicitly excludes sources previously observed empty and stops at satiety <= 8; neither is an argument that can currently be changed. probe can establish fresh local stock, navigate can approach a remembered location, and gather can transfer actual ripe stock, but their availability alone does not implement the requested bounded search. Develop a minimal general extension of the existing search controller through the current-conversation handoff, recording code reuse rather than claiming reinvention. No food, suitability knowledge, successful search or personal mastery is granted by this review. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Lin must individually complete one simulation round of study after implementation, with no added study energy or material charge and with ordinary world metabolism; neither this request nor development waiting teaches the capability. Registration, study completion, choosing targets and issuing queries earn no pleasure or satisfaction. The controller adds no reward payout. A real informative inspection, including an empty-source finding that genuinely updates personal evidence, may be considered only by existing experience rules with personal applicability, bounded award/cap, decay/cooldown and functional deduplication against the underlying probe event; search must not award again for the same event. Familiar legitimate practice need not be novel to qualify for existing modest maintenance benefits, but mere repetition is insufficient. No protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions are altered. No mood adjustment reduces basic nutrition; physical comfort remains capped at 10.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable start, movement, inspection, empty-result, collection, pause, resume and terminal events tied to the run and underlying action IDs. Reuse navigate, probe and gather visual metadata rather than inventing duplicate physical effects. Provide reusable metadata fields for operation, phase, actor, visible target, position, event tick, collected quantity and termination reason; render remembered source markers as historical rather than live stock. Empty inspections show an observed-empty outcome, limit stops show stopped or incomplete, and collection success appears only after an actual source-to-inventory transfer. A planned route, study or failed search cannot display food acquisition, restored satiety, replenishment or mastery. Do not expose hidden source stock, concealed hazards or information outside the actor's observations.
reviews.specification:
General operation: bounded resource search with reinspection and emergency modes, applicable to any actor and known resource. Implement by extending and reusing bounded-resource-search (forage:bounded-search-and-collection:1), navigate (base:navigate:1), probe (open-baseline:probe:1; handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1) and gather (base:gather:1). Preserve ordinary mode. Inputs: resource kind, origin, radius, requested quantity, maximum cumulative path, elapsed simulation rounds, cumulative energy spend, minimum remaining energy, minimum health, permitted temperature range, optional excluded directions/areas, and modes ordinary or emergency plus recheck-previously-empty. All bounds must be finite and explicit; reject an invalid plan before work. Reuse existing defaults and limits where unchanged. The emergency option changes only the controller's satiety stop: satiety <= 8 alone does not stop it. It does not suppress hunger, starvation damage, injury, exhaustion, temperature effects, terrain restrictions or death. Require health > 60, no injury in the preceding round, temperature within the existing search tolerance of 10 from 22, and all supplied stricter limits before each step; retain these stops in emergency mode. Energy reserve must cover at least the registered eat cost of 1 energy when searching for food; each movement, inspection and gathering step must still be affordable above that reserve. This is a bounded attempt, not a safety or food guarantee.
Candidate handling: visible sources and personally remembered source locations inside the permitted area may be investigated even when their last observation was empty. A past stock record is historical evidence, never current stock. Never consult hidden stock to select routes or promise replenishment. Follow the existing nearest-reachable ordering, with deterministic ties, and track which sources have been inspected during this run. Inspect each empty source at most once per run; do not repeatedly visit it based on elapsed time alone. Further checks require a separately bounded run or new observable evidence of change. Exploration of observed traversable ground remains available under the existing controller's limits; skip excluded or unaffordable candidates rather than silently exceeding limits. Sources created by another person remain excluded. No new pathfinding, remote sensing, growth accelerator or food-safety certification is implied.
An observation must be performed through probe observe on a currently visible subject using its applicable reach rules. A remembered source first supplies only a destination for navigate. Probe costs 1 round and 0.2 energy and records only genuinely observable facts with subject ID, observation tick and event reference. If empty, record that result and continue only if another affordable step remains. If ripe stock is observed, gather only within the source's interaction range: at most the current stock, requested quantity remaining and affordable units. Gathering costs 2 energy per unit and one ordinary gather round; source stock decreases by exactly the units added to inventory. No harvesting from growth counters, negative stock or automatic replenishment. All growth remains governed solely by the existing plant simulation. navigate travels at most 0.8 distance per round and costs actual distance times 2 energy with registered terrain and carried-mass modifiers. Charge real movement already completed if interrupted. Do not add a controller surcharge or invent a study material requirement.
For food, applicability uses only the actor's own evidence for the resource in the relevant preparation state. Lin's berry record at tick 66 supports the personally tested berries with nutrition 8 and toxicity 0; it does not certify tubers or all visually similar plants. assess-food-suitability (food:evidence-qualified-suitability:1) is an optional separately learned dependency for evidence-qualified judgments, not a required new study for collecting the already personally tested resource. Lin's old commons-berry-1-0 observation at tick 15 is not current stock. forest-tuber-1 was observed with stock 0 and has no supplied personal safety evidence; canopy-42 is branches, not food. Neither is a stocked suitable food source. The current energy 13.5338693 and satiety 19.8 do not establish that any route will yield food. The reported northern animal concern can be expressed as an excluded area, not converted into invented hazard locations.
Persist run ID, arguments, pending target, visited/empty observations, actual path, elapsed rounds, energy used and quantities gathered. Execute at most one ordinary navigate, probe or gather step per round. Reprice each step against current state before acting; refuse a step that exceeds any limit. Finish on quantity reached, exhaustion of admissible candidates/exploration, or a safety/resource limit, reporting actual quantities including zero and the exact stop reason. Another action pauses the run; paused elapsed world rounds count toward its deadline, but development/review waiting advances no world time. Resume revalidates all limits, evidence and ownership; never resumes an obsolete harvest without checking current reach and stock. Cancel or death terminates future work. Completed movement, observation records and collected units persist subject to ordinary world rules; spent time, energy and harvested source stock are not refunded. Cancellation transfers no items and death follows normal inventory handling, without a special refund or resurrection. There is no ongoing process after termination and no maintenance beyond ordinary costs while running. Eating remains a separate eat action (base:eat:1), consuming an owned unit and 1 energy and applying actual nutrition/toxicity; searching never feeds the actor automatically. Any other participant must communicate and act independently. Established checks, ordering, limits and outcomes must execute in code without repeated model review.

reviews.reason: The related capabilities have been checked. bounded-resource-search-recheck already supports empty-source rechecking and bypasses the low-satiety stop, but its emergency mode still stops at health <=60; minHealth can only make that stop stricter. It therefore cannot execute the requested search at Kai's current health 36. Develop a general low-health emergency mode through the current-conversation handoff, reusing the existing search implementation rather than claiming reinvention. Current satiety is 5.3, energy 15.74824218 and owned inventory is empty; the previously eaten berry is not available again. No food or successful route is guaranteed. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Kai must study the implemented mode individually for one simulation round, with navigate, probe and gather prerequisites; no mastery is granted by this review. Requests, development, registration, study and automated search startup earn no pleasure or satisfaction. The minimal implementation adds no experience reward. Actual consumption uses established nutrition rules, never a mood-based reduction. Verified new observations, including informative empty-source findings, may be passed to an existing applicable experience mechanism only if it enforces personal relevance, functional deduplication, bounded event amounts and caps, decay and cooldown; repeated identical empty checks do not become reward farming. If no such mechanism is implemented, award zero. No protected reward account, budget, goal or permission is changed; physical comfort cannot exceed 10.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable start, step, inspection, collection, pause, resume and terminal events with run ID, actor, exact target ID where applicable, tick, position, action status and measured results. Supply reusable visual metadata for operation type, phase, target, progress, collected quantity and stop reason; reuse movement, probe and gather visuals rather than inventing a new successful-foraging animation. Show empty inspections as empty, unavailable paths as blocked and interrupted work as incomplete. Only a committed stock-to-inventory transfer may display collection success. Do not expose hidden source stock, imply ripe regrowth, display eating or healing without those actual effects, or mark learning complete before its study round completes.
reviews.specification: Implement a general bounded emergency resource-search operation, parameterized by resource, origin, radius, maximum cumulative travel distance, maximum elapsed rounds, maximum energy expenditure, energy reserve, desired quantity, recheck flag, avoidance areas/directions and minimum health. Prefer an added mode on bounded-resource-search-recheck, preserving all existing modes and their rules unchanged. Record code dependencies on bounded-resource-search-recheck (forage:bounded-search-and-collection:recheck-emergency:1), bounded-resource-search (forage:bounded-search-and-collection:1), navigate (base:navigate:1; kernel.navigate; foundation-forest@1), probe and gather (base:gather:1). This new mode alone replaces the health<=60 stop with a validated minimum-health threshold: default 20, allowed range 20 to 100, stop at health<=threshold. It permits satiety<=8 but retains stops for injury in the preceding round, death, temperature<=12 or >=32, or stricter requested temperature bounds. This is bounded exposure to risk, not a promise of survival. Check current vitals and budgets before every step and after each completed step; do not execute a step that exceeds any budget or breaches the energy reserve. Require finite positive radius, distance, elapsed-time, energy and quantity limits supplied by the actor, rather than inventing a destination from unavailable position data. For food, require reserve>=1 and applicable personal evidence identifying the resource as edible; Kai's berry record, observedAt 152, supports nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 for berry, not hazelnuts or animals. Candidates are natural sources visible now or personally remembered within the bounds; exclude other people's sources, forbidden areas and unknown terrain not supported by observation. Prefer currently evidenced ripe candidates by nearest reachable distance, then optionally recheck sources last seen empty, at most once per source per run. Remembered stock is not current stock: navigate into interaction range, then use probe observe before gathering. Kai's commons-berry-3-0:observed-state (event-3-kai-21) and commons-berry-4-0:observed-state (event-15-kai-134) are historical destination evidence only. start-5-berries is observed empty; visiting it can yield an empty inspection, never assumed replenishment. With no candidate, permit only the existing bounded movement toward observed dry ground to reveal unseen portions; otherwise terminate with an explicit exhausted/no-feasible-step result. Run at most one ordinary navigate, probe or gather step per simulation round. No material or energy startup surcharge. Movement costs actual distance x2 energy, increased by ground and carried mass, with speed at most 0.8 distance per round; probe observe costs one round and 0.2 energy; gather costs one round and 2 energy per unit. Price each step using actual execution rules before commitment, including remaining energy and reserve. Gather only exposed ripe stock in reach, capped by verified current stock, remaining requested quantity, carrying constraints and affordable energy. Atomically debit source stock and credit exactly the collected units to inventory; create no food, healing or growth. Eating remains a separate eat (base:eat:1) action consuming an owned unit and 1 energy, applying real nutrition/toxicity without direct healing. Track run ID, exact source IDs, origin, route distance, elapsed rounds, spent energy, completed steps, inspections and collected quantity. Another action pauses the run; resume revalidates vitals, observations, stock, reach and all budgets. Elapsed simulation rounds include paused rounds; no hidden steps occur while paused. Cancel or death ends automation, releases any surviving unconsumed reservation once and preserves completed movements, observations and lawful inventory transfers under ordinary ownership/death rules. Consumed energy, time and depleted resources are not refunded. Review/development waiting advances no simulation time. No ongoing process after completion, cancellation or death and no maintenance cost. Implement validation, stopping, conservation and deduplication in code, not recurring model review. Other participants neither communicate nor act on Kai's behalf without their own actual actions.

reviews.reason: The related-capability searches and supplied contracts identify reusable bounded-search, safety-assessment, gathering and eating mechanisms, but not an equivalent integrated operation. bounded-resource-search-low-health searches for one resource and explicitly never eats; assess-food-suitability assesses evidence without gathering or consuming. Develop only the missing multi-resource selection and gather-then-eat orchestration in the current-conversation handoff, reusing those implementations rather than reinventing their effects. The current facts support berries as food, not the other named plants. No reachable food or successful outcome is established. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: No pleasure or satisfaction is awarded for requesting, developing, naming, learning, starting, querying or finishing this controller. It has no new experience payout and cannot duplicate rewards of reused actions. Real eating retains existing nutrition and any independently established event-based experience rules, without mood-based nutrition reductions. A probe result, including verified zero stock, may constitute personally new information only if it creates an applicable evidence record; the request or an unverified guess does not. The smallest implementation records such information but adds no reward schedule. Any later experience implementation must separately define personally applicable verified events, functional deduplication, bounded amounts/caps and decay/cooldown before enabling rewards; familiar legitimate practice need not be novel to qualify under established rules. Physical comfort remains capped at 10. Protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions are unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Reuse actual navigate, probe, gather and eat visual effects and associate them with their observable committed events. Add reusable controller metadata containing operation/run ID, actor ID, phase, target/source/item ID where known, action status, evidence-event references, measured quantity, elapsed work and stop reason. Distinguish searching, observing, gathering, eating, paused, stopped and canceled states. Mark a gathered unit only after a real stock-to-inventory transfer and an eaten unit only after consumption commits. Empty searches and unresolved food safety display neutral failure/unresolved indicators, never food-acquisition, safe-food, healing or meal-success effects. Coordinates and targets shown must come from authorized observations or personal memory and be labeled accordingly; visuals must not disclose hidden stock. No experience effect or functional benefit follows from displaying an animation.
reviews.specification:
General operation: bounded food foraging, parameterized for any applicable actor by origin, radius, maximum path length, elapsed-round limit, energy-spend limit, quantity/meal cap, eating reserve, personal evidenceRefs, recheck/exploration options, avoided areas/directions, and health/temperature stops. This is a serial controller, not a new food source or a safety oracle. Record implementation dependencies and code reuse explicitly: bounded-resource-search-low-health, bounded-resource-search-recheck, bounded-resource-search, assess-food-suitability, navigate, probe, gather and eat. Reuse the safety evidence evaluator internally; any separately executed assessment must retain its existing learning requirement. Do not grant those learned interfaces or individual mastery through registration. Any unavailable internal dependency or incompatible schema is an implementation task in this handoff, not grounds for permanent rejection.
Prerequisites: a living actor able to perform the underlying actions, applicable personal food evidence, and real reachable targets for any physical interaction. No tool or food is supplied. Accept exact personal record keys or evidence-event IDs; for Lin, the supplied personal record key berry supports the recorded nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 only to the extent allowed by the existing eating-evidence evaluator. The old commons-berry-1-0:observed-state record at tick 15 is a remembered destination/observation, not proof of present stock. Validate record type and applicability in code before consuming. Names, mature stage and visual labels alone establish neither identity nor safety. Root, hazelnut and acorn safety remain unresolved on these facts.
Execution: assemble eligible food kinds from applicable personal eating evidence, not a hidden global edible list. Consider actually observed or personally remembered sources inside the bounds; prefer currently observed ripe eligible sources, then bounded rechecks of remembered/observed empty sources if enabled. Use the inherited nearest-reach policy and real path feasibility across all eligible kinds rather than completing one resource search first. Recheck each empty source at most once per run. Remembered sources supply destinations only; probe in reach supplies current observations. Unknown observed food candidates may be reported as safety unresolved, never sampled by eating or presumed safe. Exploration is optional and limited to feasible observed traversable dry ground that can reveal new surroundings, without hidden-stock selection or entering avoided regions. Skip candidates whose verified action chain cannot fit the remaining budgets; stop when no feasible candidate or exploration step remains. All currently supplied visible food stocks are zero; branches and vines are not substitute food.
On finding a currently supported ripe source, gather one supported edible unit, then make consuming that owned unit the next action before any further search or gathering. Revalidate safety, ownership and action feasibility at consumption. At most one ordinary primitive is scheduled per controller round, and its real duration is not shortened. An existing eligible owned unit may likewise be eaten first. Stop at the requested bounded intake/quantity cap or chosen satiety target; never force consumption after the actor stops. No automatic preparation, detoxification, gifting, participation by others or access to another actor's property is implied.
Costs and conservation: the controller adds no material or energy surcharge. Navigate costs actual distance times 2 energy, with existing ground/load modifiers and speed limit 0.8 per round; probe observation costs 1 round and 0.2 energy; gather costs 1 round and 2 energy per unit and subtracts exactly the transferred units from finite current source stock; eat costs 1 energy and consumes actual owned food under its existing nutrition/toxicity rules. Eating receives a serialized action slot and cannot be made instantaneous by this wrapper; retain any longer primitive duration. Assessment trials are unnecessary for the smallest version and are not run automatically. Study takes 1 round, zero added energy or material, with ordinary world physiology still applying. Review/development waiting advances no time. Before every step, quote its actual cost and reserve at least 1 energy for eating, or the larger actor-specified reserve; before gathering, budget the complete gather-and-eat pair. No credit for speculative food, future energy recovery or unperformed actions. Maintain separate gross energy spent, elapsed rounds, path traveled, gathered units and consumed nutrition. No free stock, healing, replenishment or canceled-action refund; actual toxicity remains possible if evidence proves imperfect. Basic nutrition follows eat, not mood.
Emergency behavior: inherit the low-health search rule so low satiety and starvation damage alone do not veto a bounded attempt. Use explicit minHealth in the existing range 20–100, default 60, and stop at or below it; stop for non-starvation injury in the preceding round, temperature at or below 12 or at or above 32, or stricter caller thresholds. Budget, reach, safety and reserve failures also stop. Lin's supplied health 92, energy 9.89056216 and temperature 28.5134988 do not alone bar an attempt, but do not establish an affordable route, food, or future survival. Evaluate actual vitals again after study and before every physical action.
Progress and lifecycle: keep one bounded run record with exact actor/target/source/item IDs, evidence references, current phase, visited sources, action outcomes, original start tick, limits and remaining budgets. Another action pauses the controller; resume rechecks life, safety, stock, ownership, position and budgets rather than replaying completed work. Elapsed time includes paused rounds as in the reused search engine. Cancel, death, exhausted limits or a hard stop ends scheduling immediately. Completed travel/observations remain real, gathered but uneaten food remains in actual inventory subject to ordinary ownership/death rules, and consumed food stays consumed. Refund no elapsed time, spent energy, used material or lost food; release only unspent reservations. There is no background searching, automatic resting, repeated regrowth polling or maintenance beyond action-time validation. Normal world growth and physiology continue only during actual advancing rounds. Completion reports consumed/gathered quantities, traveled distance, expenditure, observed stock, unresolved safety and the exact stopping reason, including an honest zero-food result. Implement established transitions and checks in code, not recurring model review.
